name: Ishigami Shizuno
source:
The main heroine is a second-year student at Senshinkan Academy.
She is a transfer student from the mountains of Hiroshima, and because her father is a friend of Seijuro's, she ends up staying at the Hiiragi family home.
The virtue of the Eight Dogs of Benevolence and Righteousness is "filial piety."
